hint: An Item is a Product, Manufactured Part, Sub Assembly used in the Product or can be Consumables, Small tools or a Fixed Asset used in the Organization. It typically comes from Document Management System (DMS) with basic information. Other attributes are added based on the Organization function. Key fields include 'item_code', 'item_name', 'uom' and  'item_group'. item_group will define what type of item it is.
